{"content": [{"text": "## Implementation

- Rebased `t3code/projector-occlusion` onto current `origin/main`, preserving main’s multi-origin behavior and the occlusion/coverage implementation.
- Added explicit world-space X/Y/Z allowed-floor regions, connected-component filtering, exact candidate/refinement enforcement, validation, and stale-analysis protection.
- Published final commit `c1f6c8d`. [PR #23](https://github.com/distilledoreo/PanoRef/pull/23) is `MERGEABLE/CLEAN` with successful Netlify checks.

## Documentation

Updated [README.md](C:/Users/disti/.t3/worktrees/PanoRef/t3code-aefd2138/README.md) and added the repeatable [coverage benchmark guide](C:/Users/disti/.t3/worktrees/PanoRef/t3code-aefd2138/docs/coverage-optimizer-benchmark.md).

## Tests

- 42 files, 373/373 tests passed.
- Full fixed-first and joint optimization over 101,250 triangles passed.
- TypeScript and production build passed.
- 22 full browser scenarios passed; the final allowed-floor workflow passed on desktop and phone.
- Real WebGL shader compilation and pixel-readback tests passed.

## Runtime verification

- Real Blender production set: 171.2 MB, 191 mesh nodes, 36,788 triangles.
- Full optimizer: 24,576 fine samples in 36.9 seconds, with no browser errors.
- Final build→reference→shots→export smoke produced a valid 33,120,308-byte package.

Six adversarial audit rounds were completed. Four rounds found actionable gaps, all were fixed; rounds five and six found no remaining concrete holes.

Goal usage: 688,000 tokens over approximately 1 hour 4 minutes.
